clauses.title: The packaged guards encode the recorded failure classes
requires: Authorized paths are a maximum set, not a demand: the overlay must stay inside them
and must not be empty, but no authorized path is required to change.
immutable staged manifest, never against only the authorized changed files; and a guard

clauses.title: A true guard failure keeps its CL-D39 consequences
requires: a true failure keeps its CL-D39 consequences, terminal after editing begins

clauses.title: Luna uses the packaged guards and substitutes no local re-derivation
requires: Luna obtains every guard observation in this batch sequence from the packaged guard operations and never substitutes a local re-derivation for one (CL-D57).

clauses.title: Guard fixtures pin the surface, the named failures, and the reset
requires: the map offers the guard family and the addendum requires it
the CLI exposes exactly the four guard operations
every guard failure names its subcheck and the observed value
the aggregate alarm reset is the one the suites assert
CL-D57 records the guard family and the reviewed alarm reset
